row.evidence: Ivanti Neurons for MDM 'User Provisioning uses the SCIM protocol to automatically create and update user and group objects sourced from an IdP'; Ivanti publishes no prices ('Get a Quote. Contact our sales team to get started.').
row.notes: Quote-only: Ivanti publishes no plans or prices; every product is bought through sales, so SCIM is gated at low confidence. Ivanti is a multi-product suite; this row covers Ivanti Neurons for MDM (UEM, formerly MobileIron Cloud), whose SCIM 2.0 endpoint backs the Okta OIN 'Ivanti' app (SCIM create/update/deactivate/group push) and an Entra non-gallery app. Deleting a user in the IdP only soft-deletes (sets inactive) in MDM; hard delete is manual. Nested groups and OUs are not supported. The separate Ivanti Neurons platform also offers SCIM v2 (Okta, Entra ID, PingOne; OAuth2 client credentials) and requires external SAML authentication to be active first. Ivanti Neurons for ITSM (Ivanti Service Manager) is JIT on SAML per Microsoft's Entra tutorial. MDM also has a REST Customer Integration API to create, invite, update and delete users.

plans.name: Ivanti Neurons for MDM
plans.notes: No public tier table; SAML and SCIM are documented product features.

scim.notes: Version taken from the documented SCIM 2.0 schema URNs (enterprise:2.0, ivanti:2.0). The 'Target SCIM URL' is generated per tenant in the admin portal; its pattern is not published.

auth.token_source: Admin > Identity > User Provisioning > select IdP > Generate (token + Target SCIM URL); max 2 tokens; tokens can be set active/inactive, renewed or removed

operations.notes: Update is supported (attribute list), but PUT vs PATCH is not specified. A SCIM delete is treated as a soft delete (inactive).

deprovision.data_retained: User is kept with status inactive/disabled; an admin must delete it manually in the MDM portal. Deleting a provisioned group deletes the group and disables its independent members, moving them to All Users Group.

custom.how: Create the attribute under Admin > Identity > User Provisioning > Edit Settings > Add Custom Attribute, then map it in the IdP as urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ivanti:2.0:User:<name>.

limitations.text: Nested group provisioning is not supported; OUs are not supported (users and groups only).
Email address is mandatory for provisioning.
Updating an attribute to a blank value is not reflected in MDM.
IdP deletes are soft deletes; permanent deletion must be done manually in the portal.
Once SAML is configured for SCIM users, Local and LDAP users are also authenticated through SAML unless exempted.
Ivanti Neurons platform SCIM (separate product) requires external authentication to be active, and with Okta supports only SAML-based authentication; it uses OAuth 2 client credentials.

auth.notes: Calls need Tenant Admin credentials (examples use Basic auth); token-based auth uses an OIDC client and the client-credentials grant at /oauth2/token.

endpoints.purpose: Search for a user by UID
Remove a user account from a user group
Apply a custom attribute to a user

limitations.text: Only calls listed in the guide are supported.

okta.notes: OIN 'Ivanti' (Neurons for MDM) page marks SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked, not SAML (read from page markup); updated Aug 2026. A separate OIN 'Ivanti Neurons' app is OIDC sign-in only (c22) and 'MobileIron Cloud' is SAML/SWA.

entra.notes: The gallery 'MobileIron' app is SSO with manual provisioning; Ivanti documents SCIM through an Entra non-gallery app with the MDM token and Target SCIM URL.

fallbacks.other_sync: Neurons for MDM also syncs from LDAP and an Entra ID user source (being replaced by SCIM); Ivanti Service Manager / Neurons for ITSM uses SAML JIT.

open_questions: Ivanti publishes no prices; whether SCIM needs a specific Neurons for MDM bundle or tier is not public.
Target SCIM URL pattern, token expiry, PUT vs PATCH support, pagination and group attributes are not documented.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees a licence or ends device/user sessions is not documented.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue listings were not checked.
Which Ivanti product a buyer's IT team treats as 'Ivanti' varies; Neurons platform and Neurons for ITSM provisioning are summarised in notes only.
